content_metadata.description: In a world overrun by monsters and the undead, a group of police officers and civilians fight for survival. As they navigate through chaos and destruction, they uncover the depth of the outbreak and the challenges of staying alive.

The "zombie" hands scene is effective, but shortening it would keep the pace faster.
The final call to action could be condensed to maintain the overall intensity.
